attributes.current:
a high elf with and black eyes.
5"7' tall and weighing 110 pounds.
usually wearing leather armor under a big black cloak wearing a backpack and a scarf to cover the face.

attributes.name: character_backstory
attributes.current:
I was a high elf born to nobles of Clovania, the capital of XXX situated in the tundras and steppes of the far east.

despite being nobles, my parents were not particularly wealthy as Our country did not have much to trade, as the tundras weren't suitable for farming, and the steppes could barely grow enough to feed ourselves. 

my father, Hagas dredarius was the best archer in the town, and rumors said that he could shoot a target as small as an apple over 250 metres away with a longbow 90% of the times, and my mother Phelorna dredarius was a very prominent public speaker and part of the senate.

as such, i was taught archery at a young age, which was also a popular sport in our town. we would often domesticate snow owls to aid us in hunting caribous and other big herbivores.

we also made use of weak magic to light up bonfires, lanterns, create simple traps to catch prey and other various tasks. there were very few high elves that mastered the arts of magic in our town, because there was simply not much use for magic, as such most of us learnt animal handling and archery as our main skills.

i quickly got the basics of archery and was able to be one of the best archers of our age in the town, however the same couldnt be said for my connection with animals and nature.

because of this, i would focus more on street smarts and talking my way out of bad situations. Around the time that i turned 20, we got news that the oricish tribe of  XXX were planning on invading our country, because they did not want to join either of their surrounding kingdoms, and wanted their own land to survive, which was slowly shrinking due to political and economic pressure from the surrounding kingdoms.

we did not have much of an army, but we had a lot of archers who were used to using simple shortbows to take out smaller animals such as rabbits and deer.
we weren't used to creatures moving slowly and being able to survive hits from our arrows.

our country fell fast, as the orcs just shrugged off most of our arrows and we did not have nearly enough mages to take the orcs down.
in under 2 weeks, the capital, along with half of our country fell to the orcs.my mother was able to combine all of our forces under 1 voice, and with my father as the lead tactician, we started holding the orcish army, using the terrain to our advantage.
despite our best efforts, we were utterly outmatched for the second wave, which severely outnumbered all of our forces. seeing as there was no hope left for the country, we decided to flee. the army fought valiantly to buy times for us, and due to their efforts most of the civilians were able to escape to the west.
this is the last i was of my parents. i do not know what happened to them, nor do i dare to find out, as i feel that it will bring me nothing but despair.


i hold a deep resentment towards orcs, and vow to never help one.

i was left without a home, and was still in danger.
because of this, i started heading west towards the Nylans,, using the forests to dodge the nomadic  X raiders.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MNVbMwFm0a8DH5A4Q14_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects.

You can use your action to cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.
